sections.Profile:
"Time Fantasy" is a pinball machine released by Williams in March 1983, featuring a unique fantasy and time-travel theme. Designed by Barry Oursler with artwork by Seamus McLaughlin, the game operates on the Williams System 7 platform. It includes two flippers, no ramps, and does not have a multiball mode. With only 600 units produced, it is a rare find for collectors.
